paths.name: planned rollout executor
paths.pre_admission: rollout patch and bounded annotation constructed
paths.retry_point: operator/script retry before confirmed rollout completion

in_flight.definition: kubectl PATCH accepted or Deployment observed progressing until rollout terminal
in_flight.end: Deployment rollout terminal or reconciled unknown
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: Deployment generation, ReplicaSet and Pod conditions

generation.maintenance_mapping: explicit --maintenance-generation audit metadata; no enforcement binding

paths.idempotency: rollout ID annotation classifies a change but does not prevent another PATCH
paths.restart_persistence: Kubernetes rollout persists after script exit
paths.stale_context: request admitted before maintenance can reach PATCH after maintenance begins

paths.name: normal manual planned operation
paths.trigger: manual rollout restart, Pod delete, scale or systemd command

in_flight.definition: each API request plus resulting rollout until terminal
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: Kubernetes objects or systemd journal; script-local state is lost

generation.existing_source: Kubernetes generation/resourceVersion per operation; direct systemd has none
generation.maintenance_mapping: manual_planned_executor authorization wrapper and future RBAC restriction required

paths.restart_persistence: external effects persist; local intent does not
paths.stale_context: operator pauses between preflight and mutation or repeats an uncertain command

paths.name: Dell Fast Recovery
paths.pre_admission: failure streak, cooldown, budget, startup and GPU preflight

in_flight.definition: recovery action from dispatch start through observed target result
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: recovery event/context files are partial; no durable in-flight row

generation.existing_source: recovery_action_id, event ID, FFmpeg PID/generation evidence

paths.idempotency: restart guard, cooldown, budget and recovery_action_id
paths.restart_persistence: selected state persists on PVC but call-stack in-flight is lost
paths.stale_context: candidate survives policy evaluation while maintenance starts before wrapper call

paths.name: arena remote recovery timer/service and scoped helper
paths.trigger: one-minute timer, inactive workload or recovery action plan
paths.pre_admission: timer fire starts oneshot; timer fire itself is not admission

effect_boundaries.physical_call: kubectl exec then kill TERM container PID1 or FFmpeg child

paths.retry_point: timer next fire; cooldown and action-plan event ID

in_flight.definition: oneshot after admission through kubectl/helper terminal and target observation
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: systemd service state, action-plan event ID, Kubernetes state; no durable shared row

generation.maintenance_mapping: event IDs remain correlation; maintenance generation must be additional

paths.restart_persistence: state.json partial; enabled timer recreates oneshot
paths.stale_context: action plan created before maintenance and executed after it begins

paths.name: arena YouTube lifecycle watchdog
paths.trigger: confirmed lifecycle/availability incident after policy and budget

in_flight.definition: restart wrapper call until supervisor result and target verification
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: watchdog ledger records epoch but has no durable in-flight row

generation.maintenance_mapping: watchdog identity is YouTube-oriented and is not Protocol v1 TargetIdentity

paths.stale_context: restart decision may precede delegated supervisor call

paths.name: arena runtime delivery/stream watchdog

in_flight.end: supervisor return and subsequent health observation
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: event/budget files show request but not authoritative completion

generation.existing_source: watchdog event_id and per-resource Kubernetes generation

paths.restart_persistence: event/budget files survive; call stack does not

paths.name: CRA recovery command authorization
paths.pre_admission: recovery authorization and Central authority checks
paths.no_effect_reason: CRA owns Authority Truth and command intent/outbox, not physical execution
paths.retry_point: transactional outbox delivery using same command identity

in_flight.definition: command OUTBOX_PENDING/IN_FLIGHT until terminal status reconciliation

generation.maintenance_mapping: separate maintenance generation; do not replace command sequence

paths.idempotency: Central command ID/epoch/sequence and transactional outbox
paths.stale_context: authorization can expire or authority can change before commit

paths.name: Dell Recovery Agent command executor
paths.pre_admission: signature, ledger, authority, sequence, budget and exact target validation

effect_boundaries.physical_call: adapter.restart_ffmpeg after durable EXECUTION_STARTED and exact pre-effect observation

paths.retry_point: same command becomes duplicate; uncertain started action becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

generation.existing_source: authority_epoch/session, command_seq high-water, exact command ID

paths.idempotency: Dell unique epoch/sequence/command and durable execution reservation
paths.restart_persistence: Dell SQLite; started uncertainty is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
paths.stale_context: authority/target can change between acceptance and effect re-observation

paths.name: Dell Local Fallback
paths.trigger: monotonic central lease expiry plus allowlisted local evidence
paths.retry_point: local candidate loop subject to unresolved action and hard cooldown

generation.existing_source: local_session_id and local_action_seq plus authority epoch high-water
generation.maintenance_mapping: maintenance generation remains separate and higher-priority

paths.idempotency: local session/action ID/sequence and unresolved-action fence
paths.restart_persistence: Dell SQLite; monotonic lease is intentionally not restored
paths.stale_context: lease can expire during maintenance or target can drift before effect

paths.name: stream-engine self-recovery
paths.trigger: FFmpeg exit, missing helper, takeover, stale process or memory guard
paths.retry_point: engine loop after restart delay/connectivity gate; helper heartbeat cadence

in_flight.definition: scheduled restart or helper/FFmpeg process transition until child stable
in_flight.start: restart schedule or process API call
in_flight.end: new PID/generation stable or terminal failure
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: event/context files plus process discovery; no shared durable in-flight row

generation.existing_source: run_id, event sequence, restart_count, FFmpeg PID/start generation

paths.idempotency: single-instance/capture locks, process discovery and event context
paths.restart_persistence: process/event evidence partial; host/Pod restart changes identity
paths.stale_context: restart scheduled before maintenance and Popen/kill occurs afterward

paths.name: Kubernetes autoreconcile
paths.trigger: accepted desired-state/API mutation or unexpected Pod/container exit
paths.pre_admission: API request admission or controller workqueue observation

effect_boundaries.source_file: application kubectl callers plus Kubernetes events
effect_boundaries.symbol: mutating API request then ReplicaSet/Pod consequence
effect_boundaries.marker: owner hooks MP-01/02/03/04/05/06 plus future API audit correlation

paths.retry_point: controller workqueue and kubelet restart policy

in_flight.definition: accepted owner API mutation until Deployment observedGeneration/current ReplicaSet/Pods stabilize
in_flight.end: rollout terminal and exact target reconciliation
in_flight.crash_reconstruction: Kubernetes API objects, ownerReferences, events and container status

generation.existing_source: resourceVersion, metadata.generation, status.observedGeneration, ReplicaSet revision, Pod UID
generation.maintenance_mapping: intentional owner carries maintenance correlation; controller consequence does not acquire independent mutation authority

paths.restart_persistence: API objects and controller state survive application process exit
paths.stale_context: accepted desired state continues after owner exits or maintenance begins

paths.name: kernel/PID1 watchdog and power failure
paths.trigger: panic, lockup, watchdog or power loss
paths.no_effect_reason: application audit hook must not intercept host safety effects
paths.stale_context: not application-controlled; reboot reconstruction is a separate startup-order problem

paths.name: installed inactive legacy recovery timer
paths.no_effect_reason: installed path is disabled; enabling requires inventory promotion and hook review
paths.stale_context: inactive now; a later enable would require inventory promotion before operation

paths.name: external manual root / break-glass equivalent
paths.trigger: operator with existing credentials bypasses primary scripts

in_flight.definition: external process and resulting resource state
